title: ClickUp - Feature breadth causes a long setup and occasional performance lag
clean_text: Reviewers across G2, Capterra, and Reddit consistently flag ClickUp's sheer breadth of features as its biggest weakness for new teams, with new admins reporting a two- to three-week setup period before a team sees real value, and new collaborators often feeling overwhelmed by the volume of buttons and customization options. The desktop app can feel heavy, with noticeable lag or multi-second loading delays when switching between complex views or opening large documents. The AI add-on is also priced separately on top of every plan, meaning the effective monthly cost is higher than the headline per-plan price once AI features are wanted.
